notes.title: Presidents' Day: if you were the president, what would you do?
notes.content:
Thirty days in power and the swift implementation of the new US president's agenda is already proving to be difficult. If you were the president, what would you do? 
With the new “2017 Edition” add-on of Power & Revolution, you can play as the new president of the United States and try to implement his ambitious and controversial political agenda. 
http://store.steampowered.com/app/582150
